info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Investment Management Investment Portfolio Management-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Management API enables businesses to initiate and manage investment portfolios effectively. This service allows users to create new investment portfolios tailored to their financial strategies and goals. Financial institutions, advisors, and individual investors can leverage this endpoint to streamline portfolio setup and enhance investment performance. By integrating this API, customers can automate their investment management processes and ensure seamless tracking of their portfolio assets.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new investment portfolio by providing the necessary details. It facilitates the management of investments by organizing them into portfolios for better tracking and analysis.
